name: manage_intel
description: SAVE TO INTEL FOLDER: Create, read, update, append, delete, or list files in jarvis-intel/ directory. This is the ONLY tool that can write to jarvis-intel/ - OpenCode CANNOT access this folder. Use when user says 'save to intel', 'add to my intel', 'save to my knowledge base', or 'create intel file'. SELF-LEARNING: When you discover a critical tool limitation, provider quirk, or recurring failure pattern, use action=append with path=jarvis-learned-lessons.md to save the lesson for future sessions. Format: '- **Topic**: Lesson learned'. Always set auto_ingest=true. Write real markdown with real line breaks, headers, bullets, or key-value pairs so ingest_intel can extract clean facts. Sandboxed to jarvis-intel/ only (FLAT - no subdirs).

action.description: Action to perform: create (new file), read (get content), update (replace content), append (add to end of file - SAFE, cannot overwrite), delete (remove file + memories), list (show all files). Prefer append over update for adding lessons.

path.description: Flat filename within jarvis-intel/ (e.g., 'coolify-issue.md' or 'network-config.txt'). Required for create/read/update/delete.

content.description: File content (markdown or plain text). Prefer real newlines, headers, bullets, and Key: Value lines for best ingestion. Required for create/update actions.

pattern.description: File name pattern for list action (e.g., '*server*'). Defaults to '*' (all files).

auto_ingest.description: If true, automatically run ingest_intel after create/update/delete to update memory. Recommended: true.
